text: Power that keeps coming while you are away. Seat a crystal inside, surround it with totems of different voices, and it hums out Pulse on its own. It stores up to **2,500 Pulse**.

pages.title: Getting it running
text: Right-click the Resonator with an **Echo Shard** (from [Echo Shatter](echo_shatter)). The crystal sits inside as a catalyst and is slowly spent by the Pulse it makes, so a hard-working Resonator needs it replaced. Crouch with an empty hand to lift out what is left of it.
Then give it at least **two different voices** within 8 blocks, such as an Earth and a Fire totem. It counts voices, not blocks: two Earth totems are still one voice.

A shard and two voices make **8 Pulse a second**. Voices multiply rather than add: each one you bring is worth more than the last, so the whole ring is worth far more than the sum of its totems. The catalyst multiplies on top of that, so every tier is a real step up: at six voices an Echo Shard makes 48 a second, an Attuned Echo 72, a Bound Echo 96, and a Resonant Core 144. Better catalysts last longer too.

steps.caption: Place the Resonator where its totems will have room around it.
Right-click it with an Echo Shard to seat the catalyst.
Add a Fire totem, a second voice. The Resonator starts to hum: 8 Pulse a second.
A third voice, Water, lifts it to 15 Pulse a second. Every new voice is worth more than the last.

pages.title: Stronger crystals
text: Each second the Resonator makes **voices × (voices + 2)** Pulse, times its crystal: **×1** for an Echo Shard, **×1.5** Attuned, **×2** Bound, **×3** for a Resonant Core. Every crystal is spent by the Pulse it makes, and a better one lasts longer:
- **Echo Shard** (rank 1): stone in Echo Shatter, with Earth.
- **Attuned Echo** (rank 2): shards in Echo Attune, with Fire.
- **Bound Echo** (rank 3): attuned echoes in Echo Bind, with Water.
- **Resonant Core** (rank 4): Manifested Ingots in Echo Manifest, with Spirit.
All six voices around a Resonant Core make **144 Pulse a second**, but six voices need the [Voice Ring](voice_ring) layout. A loose heap counts at most five voices, Kinship Totems included.

pages.title: When it stays dark
text: Only **Answered** totems count; a quiet one has to be woken first (see [Keeping](keeping)). A steady redstone signal pauses the Resonator.
Ranking the Resonator itself adds **15% Pulse a second** per rank. The rates on these pages are before pack settings that scale generation.
